resources.string: Try Shallow and Deep on a sample message. Hold to see what your friend wrote.
More guides
Find and invite friends
Open Chats and start a new conversation. Choose a saved friend or enter their exact Vipi username.
To invite someone who hasn’t joined, choose Invite a friend. Review the invitation before sending it.
Choose a practice language
Tap the language at the top of Chats. Choose the language you want to practice.
Open Languages in Settings to manage the downloads for your language pair. Tap a practice message to hear it when a voice is available.
Keep previews private
Open Notifications in Settings. Turn off Show sender and message to keep the contents of alerts private.
Check the example and your phone’s lock-screen settings.
Check who you’re talking to
In a friend’s conversation, open the security number. Compare all 12 groups in person or over a trusted call.
Mark it as verified only if every group matches. To block or report someone, open their conversation options. Review exactly what you’re sharing before submitting a report.
Save and restore chats
Open Chat backup in Settings. Create an encrypted backup, confirm a new password and choose where to save the file. Keep the password separately.

To restore, sign in to the same account, choose the file and enter its password. Review the summary before confirming. Your backup contains friend chat history. It excludes unsent messages and messaging keys.
Start a group
Open New chat and choose New group. Give the group a name and select the friends you want to invite.
Review your selection before sending invitations. Open Groups and invitations to see requests and choose which groups to join.
Listen and change the script
Tap a practice message to hear it. Double-tap to switch between the native script and its reading when both are available.
In conversation options, turn autoplay on to hear new messages. It stops when you leave the conversation. If a voice or language is missing, follow the download prompt.
Understand delivery checks
One check means Vipi accepted the message. Two checks mean it reached your friend’s device. The checks change color when their app confirms the message was shown.
If a message is missing, reconnect and reopen the conversation. Undelivered messages expire after 72 hours. Send a new message if it is still relevant.
Reconnect or change phones
If Vipi asks you to sign in again, use the same account. Your saved chats stay on this device.
Choosing Use this device activates the new phone and disconnects the previous one. Pending deliveries cannot move to the new device. Compare the new security number with your friends.
Email support
Record and play voice messages
In a friend’s chat, hold the microphone to record. Release to send. While holding, slide toward Cancel to discard, or slide up to lock recording.
When locked, tap Stop to preview. You can listen, send or discard right there. Tap a voice message in the chat to play or pause it.
Hold to record
Slide to cancel
Slide up to lock
